description: The four movements of this novel. plotgen builds arcs inside these rather than from generic pools, so the macro plot bends toward the intended tragedy instead of wandering.

movements.name: The Debt of Waking
movements.question: What does a man do with a second life he did not ask for?
pressures: a body that has never been trained
not knowing the rules
being nobody on a world that ranks everyone
hunger
a licence he does not have
someone who helps him for free
stakes: a person who has been kind to him
the first thing he has owned

movements.name: Ascension by Consumption
movements.question: How much can he take before someone can name what he is?
pressures: the Ninefold Accord's registry
a Kiln house monopoly
a sect that wants him owned
the Verge Wardens measuring the drain
a rival who consumes differently
someone who stays
stakes: a person who gains nothing by him
the thin place he is making

movements.name: The Reckoning of Vaurun
movements.question: Is there a number large enough to settle what he is owed?
pressures: a continent organising against him
the last people who could stop him
a place he cannot bring himself to burn
the arithmetic itself
a plea he has to refuse
stakes: the last thing he said he would not do
the only person left who knew him before

movements.name: What Is Left
movements.question: What is a man when the thing he was for is finished?
pressures: silence
a survivor who will not accuse him
the feeling that does not arrive
the distance to the next star
being asked what he wanted
stakes: whether he tells the truth once
what he does with the count
the last unearned kindness offered him
